items.title: Russian Prosecutor General arrives in Sri Lanka
items.summary: The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation, Alexander Gutsan, arrived at the Katunayake Bandaranaike International Airport on November 25, on a special Russian aircraft, accompanied by a 21-member delegation.

items.title: Teachers, Principals to continue trade union action on November 30
items.summary: The Teachers and Principals Trade Union Alliance has decided to go ahead with its planned sick leave campaign on November 30, Ceylon Teachers’ Union Secretary Joseph Stalin said.

items.title: Thabbowa Reservoir spill gates to be opened, residents warned
items.summary: Two spill gates of the Thabbowa Reservoir are expected to be opened by 10 p.m. today to control the rising water levels amid prevailing rainy weather conditions, the Irrigation Department said.

items.title: Sri Lanka’s children under threat: NCPA
items.summary: Sri Lanka has recorded more than 9,600 complaints involving child abuse and other child-related issues in just nine months, exposing the disturbing scale of threats faced by children across the country.

items.title: Israel’s Eisenkot secures first coalition partner in bid to form government
items.summary: The party of Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has announced an agreement to unite with a right-wing party in a bid to form the next government following October’s elections.

items.title: Solomon Islands signs security deal with Australia
items.summary: Solomon Islands and Australia have signed a sweeping treaty affirming that the small Pacific country will allow no foreign military bases on its territory.

items.title: CSE rebounds as ASPI regains 21,300
